title: Civic-Tech Corpus — 2026-06 Refresh (n = 55, with AI-usage detection)
description: A curated corpus of 55 open-source civic-technology repositories from 24 organisations across five continents (North America, Africa, Japan, Taiwan, Europe), re-crawled 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-04. Extends the 2026-05 refresh with an AI-usage detection layer that distinguishes traditional/classical ML, LLMs shipped as a product feature, and LLM coding tools used to build the software (agent config files, commit co-author trailers, AI agent-bot commits/PRs, CI agents, review bots) with first-appearance dating. Also includes repository, contributor, temporal, and CHAOSS metrics; full-history weekly snapshots and per-(contributor, ISO-week) activity (commits + lines added/removed); 45+ CHAOSS metrics including bus factor, elephant factor, HHI, and burstiness; issue analytics; statistical, weekly-activity, and AI-usage analyses; figures; per-repository folders; and the pre-crawl candidate-selection list.
